description.value: Cypress Restaurant & Lounge is a full-service restaurant housed within the Rimrock Casino complex in Port Alberni, offering a globally inspired menu featuring AAA steak and Ocean Wise seafood alongside fresh regional ingredients. The space includes a 100-seat lounge and a more intimate 52-seat dining room, with takeout and online ordering available. The restaurant shares the casino's 19+ age restriction, which limits access for some touring cyclists.
